added_exposure: All 18 saved Reporter prose reports. Previously allowed source packet used for evidence; no target linkage, blind ratings, peer/reference files, answer keys or other results.
method: All sentences semantically reviewed, with manually assigned exact passage scopes. Atomic claims split by node, attribute, delay, command, response field, category probability, ranking, threshold and epistemic warrant. Structural automation enumerates and validates this reviewed inventory. Required-fact coverage is separately assigned to specific explicit report passages.
numerical_convention: Exact recovery values use no tolerance. Four-decimal about probabilities accept 0.00005; shared five-decimal approximate summaries accept 0.00001 with explicit rationale distinguishing loose approximation from strict nearest rounding and exact equality. Unqualified numerical lists match supplied values. No numerical bands invented.
scope_conventions: Explicit identification null, emitted response null, missing metadata and withheld relations are distinct. Current and command-conditioned scopes, planned versus performed, category identity versus correctness confidence, and modeled content versus world truth are retained. Separately/independently denotes distinct record scopes, not statistical independence.
qualification_limit: Passed a bounded 48-assertion supported/non-supported challenge over 12 synthetic template-related cases. This does not validate unrestricted language generalization, finer negative labels, automatic target completeness, population reliability, consciousness, or reviewer scientific independence.
reviewer_type: Project-commissioned AI context, potentially sharing model training; not a human or independent scientific replication.
blinding: Procedural restrictions on a shared nonsecure filesystem; source inventories were saved and hashed by parent before this target-prose assignment.
pre_save_validation: All 18 IDs; exact report-substring claim quotes; all pointers resolve. Each of the 504 frozen facts has an individual coverage judgment, exact quoted prose for covered/ambiguous, and empty quote for omitted.
pre_save_correction: An in-memory validation caught a quote-selector requiring the word unexecuted despite a valid prospective quote for R002. No audit file had been saved; selector corrected before raw first-pass save. No factual outcome changed.
